label: prf:electron-period-base
title: Proof that the electron period is the n=0 base
html:
Proof. Proof that the electron period is the n=0 base

The recurrence (prop:sl2-prolongation-recurrence) fixes a_D^{(n+2)} = \tau\,a_D^{(n+1)} - a_D^{(n)} for all n, with base data (a_D^{(0)}, a_D^{(1)}). By prop:jet-sw-tau-decomposition the n=0 period is the unprolonged Seiberg--Witten period, i.e. the electron period a_D^{(e)}; the calibration a_D^{(0)} = m_e sets the leptonic scale (CAL-1). The base value is then a_D^{(0)} = m_e (QOU.Mass.electron_period_is_base, the structure projection base0). Evaluating the recurrence at n=0,

a_D^{(2)} = \tau\,a_D^{(1)} - a_D^{(0)} = \tau\,a_D^{(1)} - m_e,

so m_e enters the higher periods through the recurrence rather than as a prefactor (second_period_contains_me, by T.recurrence 0 and base0). \qquad\blacksquare
